author: Fixture Reporter
content: Following Nvidia Corp.'s announcement of its $150 billion buyback expansion, institutional banking partners revealed late Friday that the chipmaker has already executed its first tranche of open-market repurchases ahead of schedule. Market makers reported heavy institutional volume pushing the stock past the $240 resistance level in after-hours trading sessions, outperforming earlier midday estimates of $235.50. Chief Financial Officer Colette Kress noted in an updated filing that the accelerated buyback schedule is designed to optimize capital allocation following record quarterly enterprise demand for next-generation hardware.
headline: Nvidia Accelerates Execution of Record $150B Buyback, Pushing Shares Past $240 in After-Hours Trading
summary: Nvidia rapidly deploys its newly approved buyback program, pushing shares past $240 in after-hours action following institutional volume surges.
